rationale: Starting recipe for IL-TUR LSI dev, scored by per-item Jaccard (ADR-0038, ADR-0043). Untuned except for being made RIGHT for the task: the first draft let Qwen3-1.7B echo the whole candidate list until it hit the 512-token ceiling, so all 96 completions truncated and the floor measured truncation at 3/90 rather than judgment. The anti-echo instruction is correctness, not tuning.
system_prompt: You identify which statutory sections apply to a case. You are given a case description and a list of candidate sections. Name only the sections the facts actually engage, and do not restate the candidate list: most cases engage a handful of sections, not most of them. Including a section the facts do not support lowers the score exactly as omitting an applicable one does. Reply with those section names separated by commas and nothing else.
template:
{question}

Name only the sections the facts engage. Do not repeat the list above.
